meta.weight_law: w_i = count of distinct documented silent-semantic ledger bugs whose root cause sits on primitive i (fix docs 2026-10-01:11-13,18-19,23-25 + 2026-10-02:04-09)

node_mappings.Repeat: real IR class (ability_tree.py:2395, serialiser table:3735) — 0 occurrences in the 305-card M21 corpus; counted as-is, always 0 here
node_mappings.IS_TARGET (FAtom pred): no such pred; real anaphora preds are IS_ANY_TARGET / TARGETS_SOURCE / IS_SOURCE / IS_ATTACHED_TO* / IS_EXILED_WITH_SOURCE / DIED_THIS_TURN / MOVED_TO_ZONE_THIS_TURN (golden census 2026-10-04)
node_mappings.activation_target_slots: no IR tag; runtime helper (query.py). IR read substituted: Selector[SelectorMode=TARGET] + non-mana Cost part tags
node_mappings.TARGET_PLAYER: never appears in the golden IR — runtime-synthesized player slot (24a); proxied by TARGET selectors in role-slot count
node_mappings.QProp(QPropField): QProp node count; the count-vs-power field choice lives in QPropField.name (AMOUNT/POWER/COUNTER_COUNT/THAT_MANY_COUNT/...)
node_mappings.result/event referents: node field `referent` in {event, result} on Selector/QProp nodes (golden census)
node_mappings.THAT_MANY_COUNT: QPropField enum member on QProp nodes (exists; 3 corpus uses)
node_mappings.static grants (p7): GRANT_ABILITY/GRANT_TYPE verbs PLUS KeywordAbility notations for {LIFELINK, PROWESS, BATTALION} — these live in the CardRecord top-level keywords[] field, not abilities[] (golden census 2026-10-04); they are the r20a dead-keyword bug payloads (design section C collision class 4)

calibration.gate: every silent-semantic ledger card: >=2 of p4..p9 non-zero; every vanilla-identity residue card: all nine primitives zero

blind_spot_classes.branch_entanglement: Tampering, Fabled Passage — the bug is in the branch machinery (design B) and cross-branch union (§C), invisible to per-card primitive counting; p2/p3 carry them (BCS 15/16)
blind_spot_classes.keyword_x_consumer: Makeshift Battalion, Mistral Singer — single exotic-keyword notation, consumer missing in ENGINE (r20a); IR shows one primitive only (§C class 4)
blind_spot_classes.replacement_x_ordering: Teferi's Ageless Insight, Caged Zombie — one replacement/trigger node whose bug needs a second card or the journal-order law to fire (§C classes 2-3)
blind_spot_classes.single_fold: Basri's Solidarity, Secure the Scene — the bug is one missing fold rule (counter->PT; token controller) on an otherwise simple body (engine layers/binder)

branch_totals.lit_so_far: deferred — lighting check is batch B3 (pack-journal signature match over tools/scenarios + 100-seed catalog)
